fact: FinScope 2024 found 75% of Batswana use mobile money, and 33% of unbanked adults already use it.

Mukuru launched a Visa-branded Companion Card linked to its Mukuru Wallet in Botswana, where Mukuru Wallet customers already manage money by phone and Mukuru is a registered Electronic Payment Service Provider.
The amended regulations let licensed e-money issuers in Botswana pay interest to customers on electronic money balances, which the Bank says supports product innovation.

The Bank of Botswana says the 2026 Electronic Payment Services regulations permit interest-bearing e-money balances and apply operating limits to payment receipts in account-based services, and urges the public to use licensed payment service providers.
Mmegi reports Orange Money is Botswana's most dominant mobile money service and has added Visa 3D Secure for its virtual cards with Paymentology.

Orange Money Botswana, a mobile money service, enters a nationwide partnership with the Taxi Association so DuelaEasy payments from Orange Money accounts are accepted in participating taxis and combis.

Mobile money has operated in Botswana since 2018, offered by Orange, Mascom, BTC and BotswanaPost, with transactions worth P33.5 billion in the year to March 2024, per The Voice citing the BOCRA 2024 annual report.
The article states mobile money in Botswana is now interoperable with traditional bank accounts.
